scenes.heading: Understanding platform terms of service before you start

sents.d: Understanding platform terms of service before you start
Reading the actual platform policies yourself matters more than any course's summary of them.

Subscription platforms have their own terms of service covering account management, who can operate an account, and what's permitted — reading these directly, rather than relying on a paid course's summary of them, is worth the time before you take on your first client.
Platform policies change periodically, so periodically re-checking the current terms (not just reading them once) helps you stay compliant as rules evolve.
If a course or program you're considering promises to teach you how to work around platform rules rather than within them, treat that as a serious red flag rather than an insider tip.

take: Know and follow the platform's current terms.
